row.amal_said: Hafiz is a motivation، بس what's about motivated؟ ... متشـ... متشجع.
row.why: Asked to recall yesterday's word 'motivated' he produced a different lexical item, حافز (sheet: 'motivation | 7aafez daafe3'; engine wrote حافظ); Amal said that is motivation and supplied متشجع (sheet: 'motivated | Mitshajje3'). He attempted a wrong word, so tier 1, not tier 0 didn't-know.

rulings.why: Tier 1: he gave a real but wrong word before saying he forgot; tier 0 is only for words never attempted.

row.why: He used هذا (this) for 'someone' after she had just modelled أكثر حدا at 46:11; she recast أكثر حدا at 46:20 and again at 46:43 (sheet: 'someone | 7ada'); he only switched to حدا at 46:45.

rulings.why: Real wrong-word slip, recast twice; distinct from A21 (بحب -> بحبه).

row.amal_said: Why? ... بس if you say the week's beginning, now you'd have to be إضافة ... It would be the first week.
row.why: He read her الأسبوع الأول as 'the week's beginning'; Amal asked why, explained that would need idafa with awal first, and confirmed it means the first week at 53:51.
row.proposed_rule: awal before a noun (awal el-usboo3) = the beginning of; awal after a noun as an adjective (el-usboo3 el-awal) = the first - same as awal usboo3.

rulings.why: Real listening misread with a voiced fix; no bucket covers awal-as-tool vs awal-as-adjective (same rule as A22), so PROPOSE.
